correctness.rationale: Verbose-barcode equality gives filtered-chain-isomorphic Vietoris–Rips chain complexes. Their degree-one filtration ranks recover the pairwise-distance multiset. An exhaustive case split on one, two, or three distinct positive distance levels proves that this multiset determines every ultrametric on at most four points. The published five-point pair is explicitly nonisometric and filtered-chain-isomorphic, so it has identical verbose barcodes.

value.rationale: Verbose barcodes were introduced to retain information discarded by ordinary persistence. Determining the smallest cardinality at which even this refinement fails on the structurally simple ultrametric class is a motivated sharp-bound question. The result identifies the exact first failure size rather than recomputing a known barcode or presenting an arbitrary finite example.
